metric: Debian popcon sourcemax installations by source package (pinned snapshot)
note: Leads are not verified parsers. Ranks are assigned only among verified paths.

leads.name: soci
leads.reason: Database access wrapper; sends SQL to a backend and has no SQL parser.

leads.name: mysql++
leads.reason: MySQL client wrapper; no SQL parser.

leads.name: libvsqlitepp
leads.reason: SQLite C++ wrapper; uses sqlite3_prepare and has no syntax tree.

leads.name: libpg-query
leads.family: PostgreSQL grammar (libpg_query extraction of the PostgreSQL server parser)
leads.reason: C library; recorded in the C cell. No C++ binding package in Debian.

leads.name: duckdb
leads.family: DuckDB transformer over a libpg_query-derived PostgreSQL grammar
leads.reason: DuckDB engine. duckdb::Parser::ParseQuery in the public parser header returns SQLStatement objects (SelectNode, TableRef, ParsedExpression trees). DuckDB uses a libpg_query-derived PostgreSQL grammar plus its own transformer, so it shares the PostgreSQL grammar family. Not yet run: a source build of the engine with coverage is large.

leads.name: libodb
leads.reason: ODB object-relational mapper runtime; generates SQL, no parser.

leads.name: hsql (hyrise/sql-parser)
leads.metric_error: no Debian source package; no Homebrew formula
leads.reason: hsql::SQLParser::parse returns SQLParserResult with SQLStatement trees; documented local text API. No Debian source package and no Homebrew formula, so it has no value for this cell's primary popcon metric and cannot be ranked under PROTOCOL.md (no C/C++ fallback signal).
